definition: The volume value area and point of control as they stand at each bar of the session, built from volume at price rather than time blocks.
boundaries: Needs exchange volume at price, which a bar does not carry; the time-based equivalents are tpo-value-area-high@1, tpo-value-area-low@1 and tpo-point-of-control@1, which already develop bar by bar.
recognition: A developing value area migrating up during the session reads as buyers accepting higher prices.

class_meanings.fx: No central tape or book exists; any reading is a broker-side estimate from one broker's quotes and depth.
class_meanings.metal: Spot metal CFDs carry broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.index_cfd: The CFD carries broker quotes, not the index future's tape, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: Broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.stock_cfd: Broker quotes only, so the reading is a broker-side estimate.
class_meanings.future: The exchange's own tape and book: the reading as its source means it.
class_meanings.perp: The venue's own tape and book, one venue among several.
class_meanings.spot_crypto: The venue's own tape and book, one venue among several.
class_meanings.stock: The exchange's tape, split across venues.

sources.quote: Developing value area and POC (live during the session)
dynamic mode shows how MPVA values are changing within the day or session

fallback.expected_loss: bar volume spread over the bar's range is an estimate of volume at price
a broker-side estimate: tick counts spread over the range, no traded size
